summary.text: Reuse the existing Known plus evidence_ promotion identity so the reader-facing confirmed-information section, executive count, and primary-evidence wording represent validated evidence rather than every raw Known fact.

mechanism.text: Filter confirmed-information cards and summary evidence wording to Known facts whose kind begins with evidence_; retain all other facts in the input, snapshot, health count, and judgment context, while relabeling the health count as known facts in all supported languages.

affectedComponents.detail: Confirmed Information contains only validated evidence facts; raw SEC and generic Known facts are not promoted into that section.
Known status totals remain observable under 已知事实 / 既知の事実 / Known facts and the three localized report paths use the same boundary.
The SourceObservation, DocumentCandidate, ValidatedEvidence, known-fact, and confirmed-information distinction is documented for operators.

evidence.subject: 来源和事实状态 and Telegram 报告

designDecisions.decision: Use the existing evidence_ identity instead of adding a schema field or provider-specific rule.
designDecisions.reason: The validated-evidence pipeline already emits this stable identity, so the report can align its reader-facing semantics without changing acquisition, persistence, or judgment inputs.

designDecisions.decision: Keep raw Known facts available outside the confirmed-information section.
designDecisions.reason: SEC metrics and other raw facts remain useful for audit, health, and judgment context; changing the reader label must not erase those inputs.

evidence.subject: health Known count and snapshot retention regression

technicalDetails.detail: The executive summary and primary-evidence sentence use the count of Known evidence_ facts rather than the aggregate Known-fact health count.
The focused suite covers Chinese, Japanese, and English section semantics; the existing runtime fixture now supplies an explicit evidence_ fact when it expects a confirmed-information card.

evidence.claim: The focused Weekly Radar report and runtime suites pass.
evidence.subject: 21 evidence-quality tests and 89 runtime tests

evidence.claim: The full Rust quality suite passes with formatting and diff checks.
evidence.subject: cargo test --all-targets --all-features; cargo fmt --all -- --check; git diff --check

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep raw NormalizedFact values in the input and snapshot for judgment and audit; change only reader-facing report selection and labels.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: report.rs changes only reader-facing selection, summary wording, and health labels; the focused regression confirms raw SEC facts remain observable in the Known-fact health count.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Use the existing evidence_ identity as the promotion boundary; do not add a new provider-specific or persisted schema field.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The implementation uses the existing Known plus evidence_ identity and adds no schema field, dependency, or provider-specific rule.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Preserve deterministic ordering, all three report languages, and no-ranking behavior.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The localized regression covers Chinese, Japanese, and English; the full suite passes and no ranking code or selection behavior changed.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not import internal modules from other features or add dependencies.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The diff is confined to the declared Weekly Radar report, tests, documentation, and governance paths; Cargo dependencies and feature boundaries are unchanged.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not weaken or delete existing tests; update only assertions whose old confirmed-information semantics are intentionally corrected.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The new regression adds raw/evidence coverage, and the existing runtime fixture assertions were changed only to expect the approved evidence_ boundary; the full test suite passes.

risk.detail: User-visible report semantics are changing, but the existing input, snapshot, acquisition, and judgment paths remain unchanged.

observedIssues.issue: Initial ai-start skeleton was not_ready because the new Contract lacked required intent, source, acceptance, and request evidence fields.
observedIssues.resolution: Amended the active Contract with the approved bounded design, raw request digest, scope, sources, acceptance, scenarios, capability, and execution decision; ai-preflight then reported ready.

observedIssues.issue: The first localized regression asserted that the raw SEC value was absent from the entire Japanese report, but the unchanged Companies to Watch section intentionally retains raw Known facts for small explicit company sets.
observedIssues.resolution: Scoped the assertion to the reader-facing Confirmed Information section, matching the approved boundary while retaining the raw fact in health/context; the focused suite then passed.

observedIssues.issue: The first ai-finish attempt stopped at documentationAlignment and reported an incomplete implementation approach.
observedIssues.resolution: Completed this active Summary with implementationApproach, evidence-bound documentation alignment, verification evidence, and the observed retry; retry the same Work Item without changing scope.

residualRisks.detail: The confirmed-information boundary is corrected, but the existing small-company observation section can still show raw Known facts by design; this Work Item does not change that context or imply that those facts are structural-change evidence.

reviewReadiness.reason: All required verification passed; residual risk remains documented.
